display_name: Three references in the Women's Employment Law, 5714-1954, recorded as typed values with their tests: the list of extensions defined in section 6(ב)(2) that stops short of the new section 6(ד3), section 51(ד) of the National Insurance Law (cited only as a target) that stops short of the new subsection (א3), and the feminine pronoun of a five-day limb in a paragraph that names both genders, with one sound control for each; not an encoding of the Law
domain_expert_review: none: no domain expert has read this against the source
seat: an employee on or returning from maternity or adoption leave, to whom sections 6, 7 and 9 of the Law and section 51 of the National Insurance Law are applied. The row asks no question from the seat because it records references and wording.

source.note: both deposits are excerpts of unofficial consolidations; a reading is CONSOLIDATION-ONLY unless NOTES.md says it was read from a page image of the instrument. The official pages read are four cropped images in amending-laws/; no PDF is deposited, because each page carries text outside the three items.

expected_red.note: five assertions. Item 1 (the definition of the extensions in section 6(ב)(2)): the citing words do not point at what the target is, and are not complete on 10 November 2026 (JUST FALSE, expected JUST TRUE). Item 2 (section 51(ד) of the National Insurance Law): the same two. Item 3 (the five-day limb's pronoun): the feminine pronoun and verb do not fit every noun the paragraph's head names. The first day Amendment 67 is read to take effect, 1 April 2026, is the builder's computation (fork D1).

run.method: one Sonnet builder, from a written brief; the page crops named in NOTES.md were looked at by the builder
